notes.title: PRICE BACK DOWN
notes.content:
Hey everyone, I've decided to lower the price already since quite a few seem eager to get the game already!

The game has a little bump in price however because it will be longer than originally planned, with tons of more levels, and much more!

If you have suggestions for level tracks please tell me here or in the suggestions thread!

Expect the actual game update soon! Thank you all!

notes.title: BACK
notes.content:
Hello! After many months I'm finally back.

[i][b]A quick recap for those who don't know:[/b] I started this project as a team with some friends, my friends abandoned the project because there were no sales to get paid after months... I also lost most of my work because of a ransomware virus so I had to start from almost scratch (had an old outdated backup fortunately), I didn't get to upload the update that was already done back then... the game was $0.99 usd originally but I raised it to $199 usd to discourage sales while I took the time to redo all my work.[/i]

With this out of the way, I'll continue...

I'm going to be honest, I was about to give up, my whole personal situation is pretty bad and the pandemic is just making it worse (lost my job months ago and can't find a new one), but I think those who got the game deserve to get something back for their patience.

I managed to redo all of the mechanics, they are pretty much the same for now so don't get too excited yet but there's plenty of room for improvement now.

I won't bore you with more paragraphs so I'm just gonna list what you can expect from the upcoming update.

- New level (the snowy one)
- The new level will not be procedural, it will be completely made by hand (the current level which is a PRACTICE level is randomized and infinite because it is a practice level, that's also why there aren't many enemies)
- New enemy variant
- New powerup

That's all for now, here's also a list of what will come in future updates:

- Option to invert vertical axis
- Yet another level
- New ship designs
- More powerups
- New types of enemies
- Boss fights
- Improvements to existing levels
- New revamped UI

That's all for now, I hope you enjoy the updates when they come. The upcoming update will come in 2-3 weeks, I'm not sure about when after that, there's still lots of work to do and I'm still trying to get money from other places to sustain myself and wife sooo... yeah.

Some pics below, bye and thank you!

notes.title: GAME'S PRICE
notes.content:
Hello everyone! The day for release is near! 

For those who wish the know the game's price will be $3.99usd AND that price will NEVER go up, the game will initially include 3 maps (mentioned in the description) BUT it's gonna eventually include 9 more! 

Depending on the community's feedback we might add more stuff for you to enjoy, like new ships and customization, that's something you will decide.

In our plans we have a monthly competition on a Special track just for that event, the competition is for charity purposes and the top 5 will receive amazing prices like any game up to a certain price, however, whether these events take place or not will depends on how many people the community has, we wish for our game to have at least 3000 players before we start with those competitions, we know that's perhaps a big number but we have our hopes up!

Oh and remember, up to 30% of the revenue will go to cancer research charity every single month. If you wish to donate directly however, here's the link: 

[url=https://www.cancer.org/] American Cancer Society [/url] 
[i]We were unable to post this link on the description, steam didn't allow it, but here it is.[/i]
We hope you like what you see so far from the game, spread the word and get ready!
